16.en: Tread carefully Mon-keigh, I have killed countless of your kind and captured countless more. But I will give you a chance, unlike your fallen kin. Tell me what you know of your supposedly merciless Inquisition…

32.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon Vipersong} is a rogue Kabal Sybarite, leading a band of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.b8x4YQfSyzlvU4LX]{Drukhari Kabalite Warriors} from the Dripping Fang Kabal, operating in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.4LYxCIJ2ansZ5wFk]{Andosk Subsector}.

40.en: He and his Kabalites move through hidden Webway portals in the Macharian Sector as they scout for ripe targets and claim captives where possible.

48.en: He aims to gain enough strength and favour to raise his group of Kabalites to become the ‘Hand of the Archon’, the Archon’s most elite kill team and trusted agents.

58.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon Vipersong} was destined for greatness. He is a Trueborn @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} descended from a highly influential family within the Dripping Fang, one of the devious Kabals that rule Commorragh, and is related by blood to the Kabal’s Archon, Vypar S’Threil. Regrettably for Varon, his family tore itself apart during one of the many bouts of betrayal and infighting that marks Drukhari life. Only Varon survived, in a single night losing his influence, his status and, though it mattered somewhat less to him, his closest kin. Varon threw himself upon the feet of the Kabal’s Archon, Vypar S’Threil, and plied his remaining favour to avoid being cast into the Kabal’s fighting pits. As a mercy, Varon was granted a place among the lowly Kabalites and told to ‘prove his worth’ by leading raids to secure more captives for the Kabal. It did not take long for him to rise to the rank of Sybarite; his tragic fall only stoked his ambition.

62.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon} is a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} caught between two worlds, once hailing from the Kabalite courts of Commorragh but forced to survive among the ‘half-born’ warrior class. He is at least as deadly and cunning as the average Sybarite, and far more driven that most. He inherited his family’s last remaining favours and knows he must call them in effectively to maintain his position within Commorragh while putting pressure on his targets. His Trueborn status and growing reputation among the lower Kabalites as a cunning warrior has gathered him a following. He chooses the strongest warriors from among them to join his squad, promising that one day they will rise with him to become the Hand of the Archon.

66.en: As with all attempts by Drukhari to grow in power, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon}’s attempts are watched with a mixture of approval, disgust, and caution. Any who rise too fast are quickly thrown down, and Varon has begun to suspect that his Archon’s ‘tests’ are little more than an attempt to put him in his place.

80.en: The Dripping Fang Kabal as a whole operates through Webway portals hidden in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector}, particularly around @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.nLrpWOo3BjHLB0FG]{Proteus Secundus, Quartus and Quintus}. Through his old ties and lost family secrets, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon }has a handful of other Webway portals he keeps secret, particularly on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.59y8WFXTbwKRwiRI]{Voll}, near Hive Sanksorak, under the rule of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#vylathi]{House Vylathi}. Knowing where these portals are located would be invaluable to the Inquisition to shut Varon down. However, if pressured, Varon would likely give up the Kabal’s portals in Drimor before sacrificing his own.

84.en: Among the few favours @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon }has yet to exhaust is the services of a Haemonculus outside the Dripping Fang’s influence. Klaevus Varaan has worked several times as a healer for Varon and his Kabalites, but Varon retains Klaevus’ services for the pact he made with a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.uybcmaEfabyk4D4R]{Mandrake} assassin, whom Varon calls upon for desperate operations. The Mandrake is a nightmarish creature that lives within the shadows and feeds upon the pain and terror of its prey, making it a nigh-perfect assassin.

88.en: Varon’s squad has around twenty @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.b8x4YQfSyzlvU4LX]{Drukhari Kabalite Warriors}, and more seek to join his cause every day.

96.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon} has made several deals with Humans in the Macharian Sector to grow his power base and influence, avoiding the roadblocks within the Kabal that would now withhold power from him. He targets overambitious leaders within the Imperium's planetary governance — heads of noble houses or leaders within the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum}. He offers mercenary work in trade for information and throngs of pitiless captives he can claim for the Kabal’s pits, more lives than his band of Kabalite warriors could claim through raiding alone.

100.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon }often claims to have more power than he realistically has, leaning on his family’s legacy or frequently outright lying to strike deals in his favour. Only some Drukhari, those higher up in the Dripping Fang, routinely see through his bluffs. The Humans he deals with are none the wiser, and many believe Varon commands a sizeable xenos army.

108.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon }has another master he must, for now, serve: Dracon Sykil Xulfur, leader of the Splinter of the Blood Toxicant, of which his squad serves under in the Kabal’s hierarchy. Varon knows he will have to kill her one day to claim his rightful place, but until then, he must tolerate her orders. Similarly, Sykil knows who Varon is and must humiliate him to ensure his power within the Splinter does not grow enough to overcome her. Sykil often sends Varon on hopeless or deadly missions, preventing him from pursuing his true goal.

112.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon }seeks a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} artefact that once belonged to Archon Vypar S’Threil and was thought to be destroyed — a Nightmare Doll. These twisted talismans are exceedingly rare and difficult to construct, created explicitly for one owner, and absorb the injuries they might suffer on the battlefield. Varon believes that recovering the Nightmare Doll will improve his position with the Archon. However, the Haemonculus Klaevus Varaan claims he can reverse the Doll’s effects and wield it as a weapon against the Archon. Varon knows the Archon lost the Doll somewhere in the Macharian Sector and that an Ordo Xenos Inquisitor discovered it. Varon is unsure how he will use the Doll but is trading for any information on the Inquisition to recover it.
